name: PasswordEncryptionType

values.name: EMAIL
values.description: password hash salted with the email address
values.note: LEGACY_SHORTHASH scheme. Verify only — never write. Upgraded to ARGON2ID_PHC on the next successful login.

values.name: GRADIDO_ID
values.description: password hash salted with the gradido id
values.note: LEGACY_SHORTHASH scheme. Verify only — never write. Upgraded to ARGON2ID_PHC on the next successful login.

values.name: ARGON2ID_PHC
values.description: argon2id with a random per-user salt and the parameters encoded in users.password_hash. The scheme for every new or changed password.

note: Selects which stored column and which algorithm verify a password. See types/PasswordHash.json — the value is not decoration, it is the instruction.
